measurement_contract:
# Round 2: all metrics at or below 1.1 LLVM

Goal remains every original workload and every existing compiler/runtime metric <=1.1 of the identical LLVM MIR0 control. Retain geometric mean as a diagnostic; it cannot hide individual failures. Preserve all13 counts, four captured compile commands, LLVM caller/sysroot, correctness and object SHA audits. No workload names in compiler logic. No cross-host absolute-time mixing.

Authoritative starting revision 029378fff38819554d9cbbad7627637828815a22 (open PR13); comparison main caeee81621248a379fe6efb5453bd93580ee5786. Round1 completed real progress: runtime instruction aggregate1.27091 ->1.13523, final profiles and accepted implementation; not goal complete. Previous task sandbox was deleted with API404/list audit; create independent task-owned instance for round2.

Starting LLVM ratios from published formal result: compile instructions1.5219064, compile cycles1.1246058, captured compile wall1.1102641, text1.9343945. Compile RSS percrate1.18-1.24. Runtime final instruction ratios span0.8996-1.5155. All must remain visible; noisy cycles/elapsed need repeated same-host evidence.

Ranked hypotheses:
1. Typed scalar snapshot/value Phi on effect joins/backedges eliminates repeated borrowed state loads and exposes compare/branch elimination. Predict runtime/load/control/text decreases on final duration/reverse profiles; invalidate if no transformed graph or unchanged full output/perf.
2. Repeated Uses/CFG/dominance/fact rebuilds consume compiler work. Predict compile profile shows these routines/stages; batch/incremental indexing should reduce compile work while preserving identical output objects. No guessed speedup before profile.
3. Representation/control expansion after inlining contributes runtime/text gap. Predict exact graph/ELF shows redundant tag paths or writes even after state SSA; needs targeted evidence, no indiscriminate inlining increase.

Snapshot contract before implementation: retain every physical write and each initial/guarded read. Address must be stable across iterations (LocalSlot, symbol or start parameter + checked constant field/index offsets); reject pointer/index Phis and loaded roots. All incoming edges must provide an already executed same-type store or load snapshot, or a proven valuePhi. Preserve predecessor order. No entry load insertion, no delayed writeback, no Unknown/opaque/lifetime/call barrier relaxation. Existing preserving/disjoint call/write facts may be reused exactly. Planned phis must be complete before mutation, bounded in number and walk steps, and must not form an unanchored valuecycle. Test joins, loopbackedge+self recurrence, guarded missing initialization, alias stores, call mutation/failure, lifetime changes and varying addresses before whole-library experiment.

Main owns compiler edits; runtime_measurement continues existing measurement responsibility, isolated environment and raw evidence. No new agent or review process.
